WS-C: EventDescription Test Suite

SMA Linguistic Sensory Layer Spec v1.2 — §4.1–4.3 | 34 acceptance criteria

Architecture: ActSpecification Superclass

ActSpecification (ICE)
├── PlanSpecification — prescribes an act that SHOULD occur (RDM)
└── EventDescription — describes an act that DID occur (WS-C)
    └── realizationStatus: Realized | Unrealized (WS-B)

Affirmative: VerbPhrase --is_about--> EventDescription
             IntentionalAct --describedBy--> EventDescription

Scope Boundaries

WS-C (this suite): Affirmative narratives → EventDescription (Realized)
                   Intransitive verbs, passive voice, instruments
                   Tier boundary integrity (AC-EVT-32–34)

NOT WS-C:
├── WS-B: Negation ("did not feed") → EventDescription (Unrealized)
├── WS-D: Tense-aspect extraction, temporal anchors ("yesterday")
├── RDM:  Imperatives ("Feed the child.") → PlanSpecification
└── Future: Epistemic modals ("might have fed")
